chapters.title: The Man They Sent
chapters.synopsis: At Forward Base Lantern, Major Calder Rhys prepares to guard a scientist he has already decided to dislike, while a dead frequency repeats a warning.

chapters.title: The Initial
chapters.synopsis: Dr. Ivo Maren flies toward a man he has not seen in fourteen years and chooses, with his whole composure, to say nothing.

chapters.title: Asset Orchid
chapters.synopsis: The briefing should be simple. The scientist is not fragile, not impressed, and familiar in a way Calder cannot name.

chapters.title: People You Mean to Bring Back
chapters.synopsis: Captain Nia Okonkwo counts the living on the river staging and decides the ghost signal is not a bad radio.

chapters.title: Scientifically Acceptable
chapters.synopsis: Ivo crosses a perimeter because the moths do, and Calder learns that curiosity is not the same thing as stupidity.

chapters.title: What the Rapids Didn't Do
chapters.synopsis: Survey Lantern's camp contradicts its obituary. Lieutenant Sable Venn needs a biologist she does not want to trust.

chapters.title: Look at Its Movement
chapters.synopsis: Glass kites hit at dusk. Ivo's eye saves the shot. Calder's hands save Ivo. Respect arrives disguised as anger.

chapters.title: Not on the Chart
chapters.synopsis: The medic treats the wounded, watches a marriage work under orders, and tells Calder the truth about fear that stays quiet.

chapters.title: The First Stones
chapters.synopsis: The causeway of Qalen-Sar rises out of the roots. Ivo almost says a name. The expedition enters the city.

chapters.title: The Same Knot
chapters.synopsis: Priya reads a glyph in which ask and finish are the same word, and watches Calder watch Ivo.

chapters.title: Lullaby
chapters.synopsis: Root nuns sing a broken Keeper lullaby. Science and tactics each save a life, and neither man says thank you cleanly.

chapters.title: Pencil Shavings
chapters.synopsis: Rain lifts Calder's blocker for one breath. A classroom tries to surface. He cannot hold it.

chapters.title: Ask It Something
chapters.synopsis: A Mirror Hind wears Sable's posture. Ellis asks it a question, and the mimic fails.

chapters.title: Six Hours
chapters.synopsis: Rhee admits she sat on a Helix transmission. The delay will choose the ground for the fight to come.

chapters.title: Cardamom
chapters.synopsis: Ivo sleeps on his notes. Calder covers him with a jacket and calls it asset management.

chapters.title: Cache the Metal
chapters.synopsis: Harun goes down the Cistern Stair without his gun. The eels are guarding silence. Pavel's voice is still on the stylus.

chapters.title: The Gallery
chapters.synopsis: Ivo crosses a cracked span for a verb. The stone goes. In the collapse he says Calder has always been like this.

chapters.title: Ivo
chapters.synopsis: The classroom returns. Calder speaks the name he never used kindly. Ivo goes still.

chapters.title: After the Name
chapters.synopsis: Calder apologizes without romance and without excuse. Ivo refuses to be forgiven where it would look like a scene.

chapters.title: Technically Correct
chapters.synopsis: Ivo's revenge is precise, petty, and survivable. Calder likes it, and is ashamed of liking it.

chapters.title: Leave the Tent
chapters.synopsis: Scent-thieves counterfeit a heat. Calder leaves the tent because the protocol is the ethics, and does not bargain his way back.

chapters.title: The Laugh
chapters.synopsis: Ivo laughs, unarmed, over a moth. Calder learns the word for what he has been doing and does not say it.

chapters.title: Too Close
chapters.synopsis: Ivo notices the tea, the jacket, the jealousy. He is angry at being misunderstood and angrier that he cares.

chapters.title: Down
chapters.synopsis: Helix makes contact. Jun takes a round. Leona Varga has a second shot and does not take it.

chapters.title: Not While I Wear This
chapters.synopsis: They are close enough to kiss. Calder stops, names the rank between them, and waits for a yes he has not been given.

chapters.title: I'm Not Asking You to Say It Back
chapters.synopsis: Calder confesses with no demand. Ivo refuses because forgiveness is not a schedule and love is not a redemption prize.

chapters.title: Orders
chapters.synopsis: Calder remains an excellent commander and puts the warmth away. Ivo tells himself the quiet is what he asked for.

chapters.title: He Doesn't Ask
chapters.synopsis: No one checks whether Ivo has eaten. The safety feels like a room with the furniture removed.

chapters.title: The Unfinished
chapters.synopsis: Partial people know the expedition's names because the Vein repeats patterns. They want the question finished so they can rest.

chapters.title: The Empty Side
chapters.synopsis: Ivo admits he misses being loved at close range. A flare goes up before he can cross the camp.

chapters.title: The Break
chapters.synopsis: Helix and a Vein-storm collapse the basin. The team splits. Radios die into a dead man's cadence.

chapters.title: Say It
chapters.synopsis: Ivo is missing. Calder searches until he finds him, and stays between Ivo and the stone long enough to break.

chapters.title: Don't You Dare
chapters.synopsis: The composure ends. Ivo says Calder's name like a person and will not leave him.

chapters.title: Day One
chapters.synopsis: Ivo keeps the vigil and reports the mission to an unconscious man. The team stops pretending this is only duty.

chapters.title: Day Three
chapters.synopsis: Believing Calder cannot hear, Ivo confesses the years he spent failing to forget him.

chapters.title: Won
chapters.synopsis: Calder has been awake. He waits until the truth is finished, then smiles and asks if he finally won.

chapters.title: Still Us
chapters.synopsis: They are together and still themselves. The Bell is ahead. The sling is not a personality.

chapters.title: Her Brother
chapters.synopsis: Leona parleys. She will help stop Cho if a record survives that cannot teach anyone how to ask.

chapters.title: The Listening Court
chapters.synopsis: Priya walks the murals, gives a few of the Unfinished their names back, and decides to break the weapon stanza.

chapters.title: Lantern
chapters.synopsis: Pavel's warning is still broadcasting because the Marrow finishes patterns, including transmissions. The rapids story dies.

chapters.title: The Mouth
chapters.synopsis: Ivo understands the Bell and feels the shape of a cure he does not ask for. Calder does not grab his wrist.

chapters.title: Cho
chapters.synopsis: Helix reaches the striker. Aegis fights with one good arm, a beta who knows animals, and eels that hate metal.

chapters.title: Half
chapters.synopsis: Cho is half-answered. The resonance is flooded, the wheel broken, Harun pinned, and the cure left in the dark.

chapters.title: The Record
chapters.synopsis: They come out of the green. Ivo does not forget. He chooses Calder anyway.

chapters.title: One Note Higher
chapters.synopsis: Six months later the team is alive and altered. A listening post hears the Vein change pitch. Not tonight, Ivo says.
